name: Apollo Rover CLI
headline: Apollo Rover CLI: GraphQL Schema Management
short_description: Apollo Rover CLI is designed for managing GraphQL schemas, federation, and local supergraph development. It is ideal for developers working with Apollo GraphOS, enabling them to publish, fetch, and validate subgraph schemas quickly.
author: apollographql

sections.overview:
Apollo Rover CLI is a command-line tool for managing GraphQL schemas and developing federated supergraphs locally. It enables developers to publish subgraph schemas to Apollo GraphOS, fetch existing schemas, and validate schema composition without leaving the terminal. Rover integrates with Apollo Federation workflows, supporting entity definitions, directive validation, and composition error checking. This skill is essential for teams building distributed GraphQL architectures who need fast, reliable schema operations as part of their development pipeline.
Publish and fetch subgraph schemas
Validate schemas before deployment
Run local supergraph development workflows
Integrate with CI/CD for automated checks
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/apollographql/skills --skill rover`
`git clone https://github.com/apollographql/skills`
